name: Orimi Kouki
source:
The Protagonist of the story. Orimi Kouki starts out as an ordinary high school student who has an encounter with a meteor right after his class ended. But before he could do anything, he was suddenly transported into another world.

Not only was the sudden transportation shocking enough, but also the sudden presence of magic arts confused him at first. He was later found out as having magical powers that are very unique to this new world.

[spoiler]What Kouki experience in Sorceress route and Alive route early half is precognition like situation but in condition before he birth with physical body in this world. His memory as high school student is copied memory from "original Orimi Kouki" and transferred to another world experience is his first time birth into this world using physical body and completed future simulating. But what he experience in soul world stored in his real physical body and recognize as memory too. Conversely his precog and loop sensation that come with headache and dizziness means that he fail to find ideal future in soul world and return to his ideal save point in addition he can't change his ideal save point as he like until he experience what he must experience in that possibility no matter what. his simulation (progressive precog and loop) will ended at the scheduled time but in the reality he awake "more early" than what scheduled first and from that time the real scenario of Alive route was started in addition his first contact with Akina Sword's stone make Akina remember her previous life too.[/spoiler]
